title: RAW UNREVIEWED: simultaneous prefix-free representatives for all saved recurrent-atom domains
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, no outcome or reading. Check whether every locally recurrent atom can simultaneously choose one value from its unchanged GDT1096 final domain, with all chosen values nonempty and pairwise prefix-incomparable. All seven original GDT1097 Iris cases are retained: four old UNKNOWN cases are primary; three old solver-INFEASIBLE cases are diagnostic and cannot be revived by a positive relaxation. This is a separately certifiable necessary projection of the existing writer, not a new cipher, extra runtime for the original solver, or native word assignment. Root selected the separate GDT1247 protocol; this card is not an execution/result record.

design.authorship: Candidate proposed by root; bounded producer checked mathematical necessity and predecessor scope. Root owns selection, protocol, execution and assessment.
design.unchanged_hypothesis: The GDT963 complete content equations use one nonempty injective prefix-free code. Original source streams, aliases, whole-page targets, permission to cross written groups, and all old statuses remain unchanged. Source atom labels are inherited formal identifiers, not newly supported meanings.

input_scope.necessary_sets: Every saved GDT1096 final domain for every atom locally recurrent in the selected case, without truncation, new alphabet, fitted length limit or relaxed source.
input_scope.identity_source: GDT1097 METHOD.md, complete seven-case enumeration; no target payload inspected during this proposal review.
input_scope.exclusions: No new manuscript/source acquisition, native raw query, image, meaning, occurrence census or reserved material.

design.exact_prediction: For each case choose exactly one string c_a from each saved domain D_a. For every distinct pair of atoms a,b, neither c_a prefixes c_b nor c_b prefixes c_a. Equality is forbidden. Every complete original code restricts to such an assignment.
relaxed_obligations: No joint occurrence placements or concatenation equation.
No singleton-atom codes or their prefix constraints.
No cross-page equality of shared atoms or four-leaf assignment.
No semantics, source identity, likelihood or independent confirmation.

mathematical_check.necessity: GDT1096 domains are proved necessary sets; restricting an original prefix-free dictionary to locally recurrent atoms preserves domain membership and pairwise prefix incomparability. Therefore UNSAT of this relaxation is a local necessary-condition contradiction.
mathematical_check.not_implied_by_pair_support: Abstract three-variable example: each domain is {a, ab, b}. Every value has a prefix-incomparable supporting value in each other domain, so even complete pairwise arc consistency survives. Ordinary Hall also passes because the union contains three strings. Yet any prefix antichain has at most two strings: a and ab cannot both be selected. No simultaneous representatives exist.
mathematical_check.example_scope: The abstract example is not claimed to be an actual saved GDT1096 domain configuration. It establishes logical nonredundancy, not expected native exclusion.
mathematical_check.positivity: A directly checked representative assignment proves only this weaker finite condition. It cannot refute a previous full-model INFEASIBLE result or resolve a full-model UNKNOWN.

smallest_test_proposed_by_root.primary_search: Finite DFS with minimum-remaining-values variable selection and forward filtering for equality/prefix conflicts.
smallest_test_proposed_by_root.primary_limits: At most 200000 nodes and 5 seconds per case, all seven cases once; limits mean UNKNOWN, never UNSAT.
smallest_test_proposed_by_root.negative_check: Require a separately written reversed-order exhaustive enumeration to complete and agree before a new negative is accepted. Preserve replayable finite search evidence; a bare solver status or second timeout is not a negative certificate.
smallest_test_proposed_by_root.positive_check: Directly validate one selected value per exact saved domain and every pairwise prefix relation.
smallest_test_proposed_by_root.no_automatic_expansion: No longer original1097 solver call, retries, extra atoms, table changes or follow-on placement solver. Root supplies the frozen implementation, validation and publication budget separately.

decisions.all_primary_sat: Projection is nondiscriminating on all four previously unresolved cases; stop. Diagnostic SAT never rescues the three old INFEASIBLE cases.
decisions.all_four_primary_certified_unsat: Together with retained old local INFEASIBLE statuses, the seven-case literal Iris domain is conditionally closed under the unchanged equation. Do not claim that the three old solver negatives have thereby gained independent certificates unless they too are independently certified here.
decisions.mixed: Retain only the exact newly certified local exclusions. Any surviving or UNKNOWN required alternative leaves the corresponding complete conjunction unresolved.
decisions.global_limits: Source-unknown frames remain unknown. Existing ZL/RF four-leaf capacity stops remain separate. No exclusion of all Dioscorides content, language, human writing or the manuscript.

predecessors.distinction: Already modeled all recurrent atoms jointly with prefix freedom and placements; bounded search unresolved. Current projection drops placements and seeks an independently checkable finite local contradiction, not a new writer family.
Produces exact necessary final domains using one-atom projections and pairwise arc consistency only for source-adjacent recurrent types. No simultaneous all-atom representative search.
Contains the current prefix obligation inside a stronger complete local model via global NoOverlap, plus singletons and all placements. Three INFEASIBLE and four UNKNOWN statuses stay unchanged.

Intersects each of13 shared recurrent-atom domains across page choices but explicitly does not select a mutually prefix-free dictionary. Its park/no-automatic-constraint-addition decision remains a selection caveat.
Runtime-only reopening was withdrawn before execution. This proposal does not revive it; selection requires the separately stated finite necessary consequence and decision-changing negative outcome.

novelty_and_reopening.completed_checks: Live route and composition topic; bounded ideas search/duplicates; route-check; GDT1096/1097/1098 followup listings; primary methods/reports and relevant1096/1097 code.
novelty_and_reopening.limited_conclusion: The inspected1096/1098 methods do not execute this standalone simultaneous representative projection. The stronger1097/978 models already contain the mathematical requirement. Bounded retrieval is not proof that no other historical record ever mentioned it.
novelty_and_reopening.rationale: A finite local contradiction could remove an obligatory source-role candidate independently of unresolved placements. A positive does not justify another weak constraint or a complete decoder. Root must retain the original closure and stop rules.
